title: Watto
description: Watto, a Toydarian junk dealer, called Mos Espa on Tatooine his home for many years. Though junk dealing was his main occupation, he was also an inveterate gambler and slave-owner. He won Shmi Skywalker and her son Anakin from Gardulla the Hutt. He forced the boy to participate in several Podraces, and would bet against him to rake in the credits. That would eventually be his undoing, however. as Jedi Knight Qui-Gon Jinn took that bet and bet everything he had on the boy. Watto lost everything and was left ruined.
